text: elaine (docs): quick QA — spotted a broken internal anchor. In /kb/runtime/faq.md there's a paragraph anchor mismatch: other pages link to #batching-opt but the header slug is #batching-optimizations so the link doesn't jump. Who can do a tiny edit to add a stable anchor or adjust the slug? dave (eng): on it — I saw a 404-ish jump when clicking from the troubleshooting guide. Can you paste the exact failed link? sam (product): if it's a tiny change i can do it now, but prefer not to change header wording if that breaks context. elaine (docs): failing link: `https://docs.redwood.ai/kb/runtime/faq.md#batching-opt` — the header in that doc is `## Batching Optimizations` so auto-slug is `batching-optimizations`. Looks like someone referenced an older manual anchor. kai (devex): happy to open a micro-PR to add an explicit HTML anchor above the header (so both slugs work). That keeps the header text stable. Would that be OK? dave (eng): +1 to adding explicit anchor. Also add a one-line comment so future editors know it's for backward compat. elaine (docs): SGTM. Could you also search for other `#batching-opt` references and update them or leave a redirect? small grep should find them. kai (devex): doing a quick grep now. Found 3 references across kb and runtime examples. I'll update them to the canonical slug and also add the HTML anchor so older links keep working. docs-bot: ci: linting started for branch `kb/fix/batching-anchor` kai (devex): PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/12901 — changes: add `` above the `## Batching Optimizations` header, update 3 internal references to `#batching-optimizations`, add inline comment. Small test added. dave (eng): quick review incoming. Left one tiny nit (trailing space in comment). kai (devex): fixed the nit, pushed. docs-bot: ci: linting passed, doc-preview deployed for review (staging). dave (eng): LGTM :thumbsup: nice and small. kai (devex): merged main -> deployed. elaine (docs): thanks all — assigning runtime team as owners for that page in the docs tracker so we have a contact if this crops up again. sam (product): awesome, thanks kai. That should stop the flurry of support pings. elaine (docs): marking as resolved in the knowledgebase sweep. If anyone notices any other weird anchor aliases, drop them here and we'll batch small compatibility patches. :coffee:
